Visitor reformats links using template interpolation

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    class _TestVisitor:
        def visit_link(self, ctx, href, text, title):  # noqa: ANN001, ANN202, ARG002
            return {"type": "custom", "output": f'{text} ({href})'}
    html = '<p>Visit <a href="https://example.com">Example</a> for more info.</p>'
    result = convert(html, visitor=_TestVisitor())
    print(result.content)

main()
```
